project: Wuxia Life P41 Habit Trajectory Player-Facing Feedback
description: Convert the now-runtime-correct habit and semi-personality system into a player-visible experience layer across main-screen summary, long-term impact feedback, echo-event legibility, and life-memory recap.

userStories.title: Audit current player-facing habit visibility
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of current main-screen, feedback, and memory surfaces so P41 only patches missing visibility links instead of inventing a parallel UX path.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory current player-facing surfaces related to long-term state across GameScreen, MainScreenLifeSummary, mainScreenModel, and life-memory summary files
Document where habit or semi-personality is already visible, where it is hidden, and where wording is misleading
Identify one primary surface for current shaping direction, one for choice consequence hint, and one for late-life recap
Save audit under docs/test-reports/p41-habit-feedback-audit.md
Do not change gameplay behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Docs-only foundation story; execution-sized and required before UI changes.

userStories.title: Surface current shaping direction on main screen
userStories.description: As a player, I want the main screen summary to show what long-term shaping I am currently building, so I can intentionally continue or pivot my life trajectory.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a concise player-facing summary derived from current habit and semi-personality axes
Use readable labels rather than raw internal key names
Distinguish at least martial/training, scholarly/study, livelihood/business, social momentum, and family bond shaping
Degrade cleanly when no axis is yet strong
Fit the existing summary card without introducing a new standalone panel
Add or update tests for summary derivation logic

userStories.title: Make choice feedback explicit about long-term direction
userStories.description: As a player, I want post-choice long-term impact feedback to tell me which shaping direction a decision is pushing, so I can connect local choices with future identity and consequence changes.
acceptanceCriteria: For actions or events that materially reinforce a habit axis, feedback includes a visible long-term direction hint
Hint wording is player-facing, not debug-style raw key output
Cover representative actions for training, study, business, and social or family shaping
Avoid false precision such as exposing exact hidden numeric deltas unless already established in current UX
Preserve the existing feedback structure for stats, relationships, routes, and long-term impact
Add targeted regression tests or fixtures for feedback text generation
userStories.notes: Keep scope to current feedback channels; no new system panel.

userStories.title: Bind mid and late echo events to readable past-shaping language
userStories.description: As a player, I want midlife and later-life echo events to read as consequences of my earlier behavior, so the shaping loop feels earned rather than arbitrary.
acceptanceCriteria: Review P26-P29 representative echo and consequence events and ensure text legibly references earlier shaping
Cover at least one sample each for trainingHabit, studyHabit, businessHabit, and socialMomentum or familyBond
Event copy communicates long-term shaping echo rather than only gate eligibility
Do not change unlock logic in this story unless required for copy consistency
Save a sample matrix under docs/test-reports/p41-habit-echo-legibility-matrix.md
userStories.notes: Content-legibility story; keep runtime logic stable.

userStories.title: Add habit trajectory recap to life-memory summary
userStories.description: As a player, I want the life-memory summary to preserve the most important long-term shaping lines from my life, so I can understand what kind of person I became across the whole run.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend life-memory summary with a compact habit-trajectory recap section or equivalent field
Highlight 1 to 3 dominant shaping directions rather than dumping every axis
Use player-facing labels and tie to actual later-life outcomes when possible
Summary serialization and existing life-memory tests remain valid or are updated intentionally
No raw event ids or internal state keys appear in player-facing output
userStories.notes: Depends on naming and wording choices settled in P41-002 and P41-004.

userStories.title: P41 regression and closure
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want regression coverage and a closure report proving that the habit system is now player-visible, not only runtime-correct.
acceptanceCriteria: Run typecheck
Run existing habit trajectory regression tests
Run life-memory and main-screen related targeted tests
Add at least one isolated P41 regression asserting player-facing habit summary output
Save closure under docs/test-reports/p41-habit-feedback-closure.md
Closure states remaining defer queue clearly
